title: 07 / POWER FAMILIES — Nature, Martial, Scholarship, Dark & Scavenging (rough)

nodes.text: 07 / POWER FAMILIES — Earth & Growth · rough ideas

EARTH & GROWTH
Earth-elemental basis. Power expressed through nature, organic materials and spiritual effects.

PHILOSOPHY
Growth. The deeper meaning is still open.

MATERIALS
Plants, herbs and other organic materials. Relics and totems can act as spiritual foci.

NATURE WEAVING
Druidic practice: working with nature and organic materials.

HERBAL ALCHEMY
Herbalists, potions and poisons. A material route into this family’s power.

SPIRITUAL FOCI
Relics and totems carry or channel auras and spiritual effects.

EFFECT DIRECTIONS
Growth · mending · healing · poisons · auras · spiritual effects.
Shared ideas for the whole family; not exclusive to one practice.

LEAVE OPEN
Meaning of growth · nature of the spirits · how foci work · who can access the power.
Setting ideas only; no rules or numbers locked in.

ITEM CONNECTION
Organic ingredients, potions, relics and totems give us different item forms for this family.
Their interaction behaviours remain modular.
MARTIAL / COMBAT · rough ideas

MARTIAL / COMBAT
Traditional fighting through weaponry, skill and strength. Close combat and ranged combat.

POWER
Skill and strength. Learned fighting ability and physical force.

TONE
Bloody, brutal violence. Physical combat is a force in this world.

BLADES & HAND-TO-HAND
Blades and other close-combat methods. Traditional warriors and close-range fighters.

HAMMERS & OTHER WEAPONS
Hammers and other fighting implements. Skill and strength both remain relevant.

BOWS & RANGED COMBAT
Archers and other ranged fighters. Fighting through weapon handling and trained skill.

SHARED FAMILY
Warriors · archers · hand-to-hand fighters.
Different weapons and methods within traditional physical combat.

LEAVE OPEN
Combat philosophy · how skill and strength differ · how injury affects fighting.
Rough setting ideas; no rules or stats locked in.

ITEM CONNECTION
Bows, blades, hammers and other weapons express this family.
Item interaction behaviours stay modular; hybrid combinations remain open.
SCHOLARSHIP / SCIENCE · rough ideas

SCHOLARSHIP / SCIENCE
Power through knowledge, mathematics and scholarly practice. Chemistry, alchemy and electricity are possible foundations.

APPROACH
Observation, calculation and experiment. Learn how materials and forces behave, then put that knowledge to use.

WEALTH & INFLUENCE
Possible uses: obtain rare reagents, fund research, secure equipment or enlist expertise and support.

CHEMISTRY & ALCHEMY
Mixtures, reactions and catalysts. Possible uses: remedies, acids, smoke and volatile preparations.

ELECTRICITY
Store charge, conduct it through linked items, then discharge. Possible uses: energise a device or empower an attack.

MATHS & SCHOLARSHIP
Ratios, patterns and prediction. Possible uses: refine mixtures, improve precision or optimise an item chain.

COMBINATION IDEAS
Conductive preparation → electrical discharge.
Catalyst → stronger mixture.
Calculated preparation → precise attack.
Possible uses to explore, not settled rules.

LEAVE OPEN
Technology level · relation to magic · whether wealth and influence affect battles, supplies or the wider run.
Setting ideas; no costs or stats locked in.

ITEM CONNECTION
Reagents, formulae, instruments and conductive materials.
Alchemy can overlap Earth & Growth; preparations can support martial weapons.
DARK / HUNGER · rough ideas

DARK / HUNGER
Human emotions and impulses mixed with outside supernatural entities. Vampirism, hunger and slow-burning curses.

MIXED SOURCE
Power from within people and from entities that engage with or exploit those feelings. The relationship is still open.

HUNGER
Taking, needing, feeding. Decide later what sustains the power and what feeding costs.

VAMPIRISM
Drain vitality and sustain the user. Feeding could also empower a linked item. Exact benefits and limits remain open.

CURSES
Slow buildup across rounds, with a delayed and potentially powerful payoff. Possible outcomes: great harm to an enemy or a strong benefit to the user.

MANIPULATION / TEMPTATION
Explore fear, desire and control. Possible uses: lure, bind or misdirect. Still an idea to discuss.

DELAYED PAYOFF
Build curse pressure → reach a large payoff.
Enemy harm or self benefit. Vampirism could sustain the user while waiting.

LEAVE OPEN
What builds the curse: time, other items, or both. How it pays off, expires and is sustained.
Entity nature and feeding costs also remain open.

ITEM CONNECTION
Relics, vessels and prepared poisons are possible carriers.
Vampiric or curse behaviours can combine with other item behaviours.
SCAVENGING / COLLECTION · rough ideas

SCAVENGING / COLLECTION
A crew member who finds useful goods in junk, recognises unusual value and manages what the party carries.

RESOURCEFULNESS
An eye for usable parts, careful collection and practical organisation. Find value in what others discard.

FORTUNE (OPTIONAL)
Chance, omens or fortunate discoveries can add flavour. Skill in recognising value is central to this archetype.

SCAVENGE & SALVAGE
Find goods among junk and dungeon debris. Recovered parts could become reagents, supplies or useful equipment.

PACKS & STORAGE
Pouches and packs add full-height columns to the right of the shared grid. A specialist manages capacity and useful arrangements.

APPRAISAL & COLLECTION
Recognise rarity, hidden properties and useful combinations. Collection could reward noticing overlooked items.

POSSIBLE LOOP
Find overlooked goods → recognise value → make room in the pack → build a useful item chain.
Supply and collection support the whole crew.

LEAVE OPEN
How finds are discovered; how rarity is recognised; collection rewards; whether salvage repairs, crafts or simply recovers items.

ITEM CONNECTION
Packs, pouches, gathered components and unusual finds.
Storage remains a modular behaviour usable across all families.
